text:
Nora (oncall): Noticing a spike in token issuance errors and 5xxs from the token-service in eu-west-2 beginning ~02:14 UTC. Customers started seeing auth failures in hosted endpoints. Declaring incident. Severity: S2. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2265432100 | Runbook: https://redwood.app/ops/incidents/2265432100

token-bot: alert: token_issuance_errors_high eu-west-2 at 02:14:22 UTC (5xx_rate=4.7%, latency_p95=1.8s).

Marta: Pulling recent deploys and config changes. There's a token-issuer key rotation scheduled at 02:00 that kicked off a parallel issuer regen job across many pools. Looks like regen jitter caused a thundering registration effect against the central signing service.

Infra: Confirmed: `issuer-regenerator:v3` was deployed at 01:58 and started regenerating keys across pools without a jitter/backoff. Spawning many signing requests to signer-primary. I'm throttling regen workers and temporarily disabling parallel regen: `infractl set-config issuer.regen_parallelism=1 --region eu-west-2`

deploy-bot: config change recorded: issuer.regen_parallelism 10 -> 1 at 02:17:03 UTC.

Nora (oncall): Also seeing increased cache misses on token-cache layer. As emergency mitigation enabling local signing cache and bumping TTL to reduce signer load. Command: `edgectl feature-flip token-local-cache --enable --ttl=300s --region=eu-west-2`

Telemetry: After throttling and cache enablement, token 5xx rate dropped from 4.7% -> 0.6% within 4 minutes. p95 latency improved 1.8s -> 360ms. Query used: `sum(rate(token_5xx_total{region="eu-west-2"}[1m])) by (instance)`

Marta: Rolling back the regen job to the staggered rollout pattern and adding exponential backoff. Patch applied to `issuer-regenerator:v3` and queued for canary redeploy. Patch diff: reduce parallelism loop and add randomized delay 0-30s per pool. Will push to incident doc.

Infra: Follow-up mitigation: scaled signer-primary horizontally by +2 replicas to absorb backlogged signing requests while cache warms. Command: `kubectl scale deployment/signer-primary --replicas=6 -n auth-prod`

Customer Success: Notifying impacted customers and updating status page: "Token issuance errors observed in eu-west-2 due to a key regeneration job. We've applied mitigations and services are recovering. We'll provide an RCA when available." Draft: https://redwood.app/internal/comms/2265432100

Telemetry: Added temporary alert: token_signer_queue_depth > 50 sustained 2m -> page oncall. Also adding a per-deploy canary metric for regen jobs to detect regen-driven signing spikes.

Nora (oncall): Current status: mitigated (primary mitigations applied, token latency and error rates dropping). Monitoring for 45min. RCA owners: Marta (regen job), Infra (signer scaling & cache), Telemetry (alerts & dashboards), Customer Success (customer comms).

Marta: Planned follow-ups in RCA: add jittered rollout to regen pipeline, implement per-pool backpressure, add automatic disable if signer error rate > 1% during regen, and capture safe default TTLs for local token cache.

Infra: Also recommending a deploy-lint rule that disallows regen_parallelism > 2 in prod without an explicit canary.

Customer Success: Status page updated to "Operational (mitigated)" and targeted DMs sent to affected tenants.

Nora (oncall): Closing the incident thread; will reopen if error rate climbs again. Thanks all for quick response.

(Agent notes: canonical links above; follow-up owners: Marta/Infra/Telemetry/Customer Success.)
